correctness.rationale: Invariance under diagonal translation in characteristic 3 gives the cone. Exact four-chart Jacobian scheme lengths (12 each) and 12 distinct rational solutions per chart exhaust all 15 geometric singularities; local Hessian ranks are 3. The normal quartic has a crepant K3 resolution. Verified point counts 25 and 145 yield resolution counts 70 and 280. Equality with 1+81+22*9 implies all 22 squared Frobenius eigenvalues equal 9, and the degree-one trace fixes multiplicities 21 and 1. The proof supplies all extension counts.

value.rationale: The symmetric quartic is the classical moduli-related Igusa hypersurface. Its characteristic-three cone degeneration retains a sharply classified 15-node surface and its minimal resolution attains the F9 Weil bound. The single exceptional Frobenius sign and zeta formulas give natural complete arithmetic invariants, rather than merely rephrasing known incidence combinatorics. The exact computations are small but mathematically motivated and determine all finite extensions.
